narrative:
Injury news dominates this week, and none of it's good. Rashee Rice picks up a new Suspended tag, while Quinshon Judkins and MarShawn Lloyd are both flipping to OUT — Jonathon Brooks lands on the PUP list and Jalen Coker heads to IR. That's five names your bench just got a lot more crowded with, so start shopping now.

The one real debate on the board is Dak Prescott, where the experts can't agree on anything: Mike Harmon has him as high as QB5, Nathan Jahnke buries him at QB21, and the full range spans 6 to 20. When the spread is that wide, trust your own read on the matchup.
